findings.summary: Anyone who can reach the receiver can make health report a false secret mismatch: verifySignature calls recordRefusal for every request with a missing or bad signature before any trust check. Impact is limited to spoofing the health signal; no event is accepted without a valid signature. Consider recording a refusal only when a well-formed signature header is present, or document that the reason can be forged on a tunnel feed.

findings.summary: Still not fixed (raised in rounds 1 and 2). verifySignature calls recordRefusal on every request whose signature is missing or invalid, before any trust check.
